title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
summary: 從輪載經面板、縱肋、橫梁到主梁的局部與整體傳力出發，以疲勞為主控計算面板厚度，再處理 U 形肋冷彎、肋—面板部分滲透焊、面板單元焊接變形、工地拼接收縮、非破壞檢測與試拼裝，最後以鋪面協同、疲勞熱點檢查與裂縫成長評估交接，並以金門大橋 1982 至 1986 年換裝鋼橋面、Lions Gate 橋與 Millau 高架橋為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from the local and global load path from wheel to deck plate, ribs, floorbeams and main girders, size the deck plate with fatigue governing, then handle cold-formed U-ribs, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, panel welding distortion, site-splice shrinkage, non-destructive testing and trial assembly, and finally hand over with surfacing interaction, fatigue hot-spot inspection and crack-growth assessment, using the Golden Gate Bridge's 1982–1986 redecking, Lions Gate and Millau as cases.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計取捨練習：一座寬 30 m、長 1,000 m 的鋼橋面（面積 30,000 m²），比較面板厚度 12、16、18 mm。局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比：由 12 mm 改為 16 mm，應力幅降為 (12/16)² ≈ 0.56 倍，以 m = 3 的 S–N 曲線計，疲勞壽命約增為 (16/12)⁶ ≈ 5.6 倍；增加的鋼重為 0.004 m × 7,850 kg/m³ = 31.4 kg/m²，全橋約 31.4×30,000/1,000 ≈ 942 t。再由 16 mm 加到 18 mm，應力幅降為 (16/18)² ≈ 0.79 倍，壽命約增為 (18/16)⁶ ≈ 2.0 倍，增重 15.7 kg/m²，全橋約 471 t。若再考慮常溫鋪面合成可使板條勁度增為約 5.3 倍、夏季高溫只剩約 1.9 倍，設計應以高溫狀態檢核重車道細部。結論：在重車道使用較厚面板、在輕載區維持標準厚度，是兼顧重量與疲勞的常見作法。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Trade-off exercise: a steel deck 30 m wide and 1,000 m long (30,000 m²) compares deck plates of 12, 16 and 18 mm. Local bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness: going from 12 mm to 16 mm cuts the stress range to (12/16)² ≈ 0.56 times, so with an m = 3 S–N curve the fatigue life rises about (16/12)⁶ ≈ 5.6 times; the added steel is 0.004 m × 7,850 kg/m³ = 31.4 kg/m², about 31.4×30,000/1,000 ≈ 942 t for the bridge. Going on from 16 mm to 18 mm cuts the stress range to (16/18)² ≈ 0.79 times and raises life about (18/16)⁶ ≈ 2.0 times for 15.7 kg/m², about 471 t. Allowing for surfacing composite action, which raises strip stiffness about 5.3 times at moderate temperature but only about 1.9 times in summer heat, heavy-lane details should be checked for the hot condition. Conclusion: thicker plates in heavy lanes and standard thickness elsewhere is a common balance of weight and fatigue. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」與「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" and "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。輪載先使面板在相鄰肋腹板之間局部受彎，再由縱肋把荷重以連續梁方式傳到橫梁，橫梁再傳到主梁或箱梁腹板；同時整片面板與縱肋又是主梁的上翼板，承受整體彎曲的縱向應力。這種一板多用的設計使橋面重量遠低於混凝土橋面，因此長跨懸索橋、斜張橋與活動橋普遍採用，但也意味著每一處焊接細部都承受局部與整體應力的疊加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name. A wheel load first bends the deck plate locally between adjacent rib webs; the ribs then carry the load as continuous beams to the floorbeams, which pass it to the main girders or box webs. At the same time the deck plate and ribs act as the top flange of the main girder, carrying longitudinal stress from global bending. This multiple use makes the deck far lighter than concrete, so long suspension, cable-stayed and movable bridges widely adopt it, but it also means every welded detail sees local and global stresses superimposed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輪載 P = 75 kN、輪印長 0.4 m，面板在肋腹板間跨距 s = 0.3 m 以兩端固定板條計：w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m，M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m；面板 16 mm 時 S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³，σ ≈ 82 MPa；12 mm 時 σ ≈ 146 MPa，增加約 78%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a wheel load P = 75 kN on a 0.4 m long patch and a deck plate spanning s = 0.3 m between rib webs as a fixed-ended strip, w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m and M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m; with a 16 mm plate S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³ and σ ≈ 82 MPa; with 12 mm, σ ≈ 146 MPa, about 78% more.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輪載 P = 75 kN、輪印長 0.4 m，面板在肋腹板間跨距 s = 0.3 m 以兩端固定板條計：w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m，M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m；面板 16 mm 時 S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³，σ ≈ 82 MPa；12 mm 時 σ ≈ 146 MPa，增加約 78%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a wheel load P = 75 kN on a 0.4 m long patch and a deck plate spanning s = 0.3 m between rib webs as a fixed-ended strip, w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m and M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m; with a 16 mm plate S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³ and σ ≈ 82 MPa; with 12 mm, σ ≈ 146 MPa, about 78% more. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計報告須同時提供整體與局部模型的關鍵細部應力表，並標示重車道與輪跡位置；製造廠的焊接程序與檢驗計畫必須依這些關鍵細部分級，而不是對所有焊縫一視同仁。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design report must give tables of key detail stresses from both global and local models and mark heavy lanes and wheel paths; the fabricator's welding procedures and inspection plan must be graded by these key details rather than treating every weld alike.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種一板多用的設計使橋面重量遠低於混凝土橋面，因此長跨懸索橋、斜張橋與活動橋普遍採用，但也意味著每一處焊接細部都承受局部與整體應力的疊加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This multiple use makes the deck far lighter than concrete, so long suspension, cable-stayed and movable bridges widely adopt it, but it also means every welded detail sees local and global stresses superimposed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。焊接細部的疲勞壽命依 S–N 曲線與應力幅的三次方成反比，而面板局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比，所以面板稍微加厚，壽命就大幅增加。FHWA 2012 年手冊把面板最小厚度提高到 14 至 16 mm 列為近年改進之一，正是早期薄面板疲勞經驗的反映。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. Welded-detail fatigue life is inversely proportional to the cube of stress range on the S–N curve, while local plate bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness, so a slightly thicker plate greatly extends life. FHWA's 2012 manual lists raising the minimum deck-plate thickness to 14 to 16 mm among recent improvements, reflecting the fatigue experience of early thin plates. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rib-to-deck weld stress range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Welded-detail fatigue life is inversely proportional to the cube of stress range on the S–N curve, while local plate bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness, so a slightly thicker plate greatly extends life.

knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness" is correct?
options: 鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。
縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。
正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。
optionsEn: If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.
Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century.
quiz.explanation: 正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。16 mm 面板應力幅 45 MPa：N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶；改用 12 mm，應力幅乘 (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 成為 80 MPa，N ≈ 1.4×10⁶，壽命只剩約 1/5.6。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa. A 16 mm plate with a 45 MPa stress range gives N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶; a 12 mm plate multiplies the stress range by (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 to 80 MPa, giving N ≈ 1.4×10⁶, about 1/5.6 of the life. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限；新型細部或沒有規範類別的細部，須以足尺疲勞試驗驗證，試體的焊接程序必須與量產一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage; new details without a code category need full-scale fatigue tests whose specimens are welded with the same procedure as production.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。16 mm 面板應力幅 45 MPa：N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶；改用 12 mm，應力幅乘 (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 成為 80 MPa，N ≈ 1.4×10⁶，壽命只剩約 1/5.6。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa. A 16 mm plate with a 45 MPa stress range gives N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶; a 12 mm plate multiplies the stress range by (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 to 80 MPa, giving N ≈ 1.4×10⁶, about 1/5.6 of the life. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限；新型細部或沒有規範類別的細部，須以足尺疲勞試驗驗證，試體的焊接程序必須與量產一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage; new details without a code category need full-scale fatigue tests whose specimens are welded with the same procedure as production. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主規範應明訂面板最小厚度、縱肋最小厚度與關鍵細部的疲勞類別，並要求新細部須有試驗依據；設計審查時把疲勞計算列為必審項目，而不是附錄。

steps.objective: 說明「U 形縱肋冷彎成型」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cold-formed U-ribs” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 現代正交異性橋面多採閉口梯形或 U 形縱肋，由 6 至 10 mm 鋼板冷彎成型，抗扭勁度高，能把輪載分散到相鄰肋，且每延公尺需要的焊縫比開口肋少。冷彎時外緣纖維產生很大的塑性應變，會降低鋼材韌性並可能出現微裂，因此彎曲內半徑、鋼材的韌性等級與彎後檢查都要事先規定。閉口肋內部無法進入，所以肋的兩端要封閉或做好防蝕，肋本身的直線度與開口寬度也直接決定日後與面板的組裝間隙。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「U 形縱肋冷彎成型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modern orthotropic decks mostly use closed trapezoidal or U-shaped ribs cold-bent from 6 to 10 mm plate, with high torsional stiffness that spreads wheel loads to neighbouring ribs and fewer welds per metre than open ribs. The inside of a closed rib is inaccessible, so its ends must be sealed or protected against corrosion, and the rib's straightness and opening width directly govern the later fit-up gap to the deck plate. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cold-formed U-ribs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「U 形縱肋冷彎成型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：冷彎外緣應變 ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t)。肋厚 t = 8 mm、內半徑 r_i = 4t = 32 mm：ε = 8/(64 + 8) ≈ 11%。U 肋頂寬 300 mm、底寬 180 mm、高 300 mm 時，斜腹板長 √(300² + 60²) ≈ 306 mm，展開寬約 180 + 2×306 ≈ 792 mm，每公尺重 0.792×0.008×7,850 ≈ 49.7 kg。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Outer-fibre bending strain ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t). For t = 8 mm and r_i = 4t = 32 mm, ε = 8/(64 + 8) ≈ 11%. Values are teaching assumptions. steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On receipt, check mill certificates for chemistry, strength and impact toughness; after bending, spot-check bends by magnetic-particle or dye-penetrant testing and measure opening width, web angle and full-length straightness against tolerances; for the first batch, section samples to confirm no cracking on the inside or outside of the bends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.titleEn: Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「肋—面板部分滲透焊」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 閉口肋只能從外側焊接，所以肋—面板焊縫是單面部分滲透焊：熔深太淺，未熔合的根部像一道預存裂縫，在輪載反覆下由根部向面板或焊趾成長；熔深太深則燒穿，在肋內形成焊瘤與缺口。FHWA 手冊強調此焊縫須控制熔深且不得燒穿。肋穿過橫梁時，橫梁腹板常在肋底部留下開孔，讓肋在輪載下能有限度地轉動，降低肋—橫梁焊縫的拘束應力；開孔形狀、焊縫包角與切割面品質都是疲勞敏感處。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「肋—面板部分滲透焊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A closed rib can only be welded from outside, so the rib-to-deck weld is a one-sided partial-penetration weld: too shallow and the unfused root acts as a built-in crack that grows under repeated wheel loads into the deck plate or toe; too deep and it melts through, leaving drop-through and notches inside the rib. FHWA's manual stresses controlled penetration with no melt-through. Where ribs pass through floorbeams, the floorbeam web usually has a cut-out below the rib so the rib can rotate a little under wheel loads, reducing restraint stresses in the rib-to-floorbeam weld; cut-out shape, weld wrap-around and cut-edge quality are all fatigue-sensitive. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：肋壁 8 mm，若目標熔深 80% 為 6.4 mm、下限 70% 為 5.6 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an 8 mm rib wall, an 80% penetration target is 6.4 mm and a 70% minimum is 5.6 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「肋—面板部分滲透焊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：肋壁 8 mm，若目標熔深 80% 為 6.4 mm、下限 70% 為 5.6 mm。潛弧焊熱輸入 Q = V·I·60/(1,000·v)：30 V、600 A、行進速度 500 mm/min，Q = 30×600×60/(1,000×500) = 2.16 kJ/mm；速度降到 400 mm/min 時 Q 升為 2.7 kJ/mm，熔深加大、燒穿風險上升。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an 8 mm rib wall, an 80% penetration target is 6.4 mm and a 70% minimum is 5.6 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：焊接程序評定須以實際肋與面板組合做試焊，切取多個斷面做巨觀蝕刻量測熔深與根部形狀；量產時依規定頻率（例如每一面板單元的端部延伸段）切取試片，並以相位陣列超音波沿線檢查熔深，與程序評定結果比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Welding procedure qualification must use real rib and plate assemblies, sectioning several locations for macro-etch measurement of penetration and root shape; in production, cut test pieces at the specified frequency, for example from run-off extensions on each panel, and scan penetration along the weld with phased-array ultrasonics for comparison with the qualification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.titleEn: Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「肋—面板部分滲透焊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 焊接程序評定須以實際肋與面板組合做試焊，切取多個斷面做巨觀蝕刻量測熔深與根部形狀；量產時依規定頻率（例如每一面板單元的端部延伸段）切取試片，並以相位陣列超音波沿線檢查熔深，與程序評定結果比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Welding procedure qualification must use real rib and plate assemblies, sectioning several locations for macro-etch measurement of penetration and root shape; in production, cut test pieces at the specified frequency, for example from run-off extensions on each panel, and scan penetration along the weld with phased-array ultrasonics for comparison with the qualification. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：肋—面板焊接應以自動化設備、固定姿勢與經評定的參數施焊，組裝間隙在焊前逐段檢查並記錄；開孔以數控切割並規定表面粗糙度與研磨要求，關鍵焊縫的焊工資格與參數紀錄須可追溯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Rib-to-deck welds should be made with automated equipment in a fixed position with qualified parameters, with fit-up gaps checked and recorded section by section before welding; cut-outs are CNC cut with specified roughness and grinding, and welder qualifications and parameter records for key welds must be traceable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：組裝間隙忽大忽小，固定焊接參數下熔深隨之變化，間隙大處燒穿、間隙小處熔深不足；開孔切割面粗糙或焊縫包角不完整，橫梁腹板在開孔端部出現疲勞裂縫並向腹板內擴展。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With a gap that varies along the rib and fixed welding parameters, penetration varies with it: melt-through where the gap is large and too little penetration where it is tight; rough cut-out edges or incomplete weld wrap-around let fatigue cracks start at cut-out ends and grow into the floorbeam web. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「肋—面板部分滲透焊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 組裝間隙忽大忽小，固定焊接參數下熔深隨之變化，間隙大處燒穿、間隙小處熔深不足；開孔切割面粗糙或焊縫包角不完整，橫梁腹板在開孔端部出現疲勞裂縫並向腹板內擴展。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With a gap that varies along the rib and fixed welding parameters, penetration varies with it: melt-through where the gap is large and too little penetration where it is tight; rough cut-out edges or incomplete weld wrap-around let fatigue cracks start at cut-out ends and grow into the floorbeam web. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：肋穿過橫梁時，橫梁腹板常在肋底部留下開孔，讓肋在輪載下能有限度地轉動，降低肋—橫梁焊縫的拘束應力；開孔形狀、焊縫包角與切割面品質都是疲勞敏感處。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Where ribs pass through floorbeams, the floorbeam web usually has a cut-out below the rib so the rib can rotate a little under wheel loads, reducing restraint stresses in the rib-to-floorbeam weld; cut-out shape, weld wrap-around and cut-edge quality are all fatigue-sensitive.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面板單元製作與焊接變形控制」與「工地拼接與焊接收縮預留」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Panel fabrication and welding distortion control" and "Site splices and shrinkage allowance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面板單元製作與焊接變形控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel fabrication and welding distortion control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「反變形胎架」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pre-cambered welding jig” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 面板單元通常是數公尺寬、十餘公尺長的面板配上數根 U 肋，大量長焊縫集中在面板一側，焊後冷卻收縮會使面板縱向彎曲並在肋間產生橫向角變形。若不控制，面板單元在組成箱梁時無法密合，工地拼接間隙不均，鋪面也難以平整。工廠常用反變形胎架把面板預先彎成與焊接收縮方向相反的形狀，配合對稱焊接順序與夾具，使焊後回彈到設計形狀；必要時再以火焰矯正，但火焰矯正溫度須受控，以免改變鋼材性質。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「反變形胎架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A panel unit is usually a deck plate a few metres wide and over ten metres long with several U-ribs, concentrating many long welds on one side; cooling shrinkage bows the panel longitudinally and causes angular distortion between ribs. Uncontrolled, panels will not fit when assembled into box girders, site-splice gaps become uneven and the surfacing is hard to finish flat. Shops use pre-cambered jigs that bend the panel opposite to the weld shrinkage, together with symmetrical welding sequences and clamps, so it springs back to the design shape; flame straightening may follow if needed, but its temperature must be controlled so the steel's properties are not altered. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pre-cambered welding jig” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：寬 3.6 m、16 mm 面板配 6 根 8 mm U 肋，中性軸在面板下約 0.073 m，I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 3.6 m wide, 16 mm plate with six 8 mm U-ribs, the neutral axis lies about 0.073 m below the plate and I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「反變形胎架」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pre-cambered welding jig”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Panel fabrication and welding distortion control
knowledge.text: 面板單元通常是數公尺寬、十餘公尺長的面板配上數根 U 肋，大量長焊縫集中在面板一側，焊後冷卻收縮會使面板縱向彎曲並在肋間產生橫向角變形。若不控制，面板單元在組成箱梁時無法密合，工地拼接間隙不均，鋪面也難以平整。

knowledge.text: 誤解：焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「面板單元製作與焊接變形控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。

steps.title: 面板單元製作與焊接變形控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Panel fabrication and welding distortion control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反變形胎架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pre-cambered welding jig” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：寬 3.6 m、16 mm 面板配 6 根 8 mm U 肋，中性軸在面板下約 0.073 m，I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴。12 道焊縫各產生 120 kN 收縮力，合計 1,440 kN，作用在面板高度，彎矩 M ≈ 1,440×0.073 ≈ 105 kN·m；12 m 長單元的拱度 δ = M·L²/(8EI) = 105×12²/(8×2.1×10⁸×1.15×10⁻³) ≈ 7.9 mm，胎架預彎量以此為初值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 3.6 m wide, 16 mm plate with six 8 mm U-ribs, the neutral axis lies about 0.073 m below the plate and I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴. Twelve weld lines each shrinking with 120 kN give 1,440 kN at plate level, M ≈ 1,440×0.073 ≈ 105 kN·m; over a 12 m unit the bow is δ = M·L²/(8EI) = 105×12²/(8×2.1×10⁸×1.15×10⁻³) ≈ 7.9 mm, the starting value for the jig pre-camber. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：首批面板單元焊前、焊後與冷卻後以三維量測記錄縱向拱度、肋間角變形與面板平整度，與預測比較並修正胎架預彎量與焊接順序；量產後每一單元出廠前量測並與允差比較，火焰矯正區域記錄位置與溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For the first panels, survey longitudinal bow, angular distortion between ribs and plate flatness in 3D before welding, after welding and after cooling, compare with prediction and adjust the jig pre-camber and welding sequence; in production, measure every unit before dispatch against tolerances and record the location and temperature of any flame straightening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 面板單元在工廠組成箱梁節段後，於工地或預拼場對接：面板以單面焊加陶瓷襯墊做全滲透對接焊，縱肋則因無法從內部焊接，常以一段短的嵌補肋在兩端與既有肋對接，或改用高強度螺栓拼接板。每一道橫向對接焊冷卻時都會縮短一點，數十道累積起來就可能讓整跨鋼梁長度不足，因此節段製作長度必須預留收縮量。拼接順序也很關鍵：先焊面板再焊縱肋，或反之，會產生不同的拘束應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「肋拼接嵌補段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Each transverse butt weld shortens a little as it cools, and dozens of them can leave a whole span short, so segment fabrication lengths must include a shrinkage allowance. Splice sequence also matters: welding the deck plate first or the ribs first produces different restraint stresses. steps.observation: 如何核對：以工廠試焊量測實際橫向收縮量，作為放樣加長的依據；工地拼接前量測兩節段端面的間隙、錯邊與肋的對位，焊後量測收縮並更新累積值；面板對接焊以超音波或射線檢測，嵌補肋焊縫以磁粉檢測加超音波檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance; before each site splice, measure gap, misalignment and rib registration at the two segment faces, measure shrinkage after welding and update the running total; test deck butt welds by ultrasonics or radiography and insert-rib welds by magnetic particle plus ultrasonics.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主跨 360 m 由 30 道橫向工地對接組成，每道對接焊收縮約 1.5 mm，累積 30×1.5 = 45 mm；節段放樣須平均每段加長 1.5 mm，否則跨中閉合缺口約 45 mm，需另行加長嵌補段。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 360 m main span with 30 transverse site butt joints, each shrinking about 1.5 mm, shortens by 30×1.5 = 45 mm; each segment must be laid out 1.5 mm longer on average, otherwise the midspan closure gap is about 45 mm short and needs a longer insert. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「工地拼接與焊接收縮預留」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site splices and shrinkage allowance", which statement holds?
options: 鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。
主跨 360 m 由 30 道橫向工地對接組成，每道對接焊收縮約 1.5 mm，累積 30×1.5 = 45 mm。
鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。
optionsEn: Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn.
A 360 m main span with 30 transverse site butt joints, each shrinking about 1.5 mm, shortens by 30×1.5 = 45 mm.
A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.
quiz.explanation: 主跨 360 m 由 30 道橫向工地對接組成，每道對接焊收縮約 1.5 mm，累積 30×1.5 = 45 mm；節段放樣須平均每段加長 1.5 mm，否則跨中閉合缺口約 45 mm，需另行加長嵌補段。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 360 m main span with 30 transverse site butt joints, each shrinking about 1.5 mm, shortens by 30×1.5 = 45 mm; each segment must be laid out 1.5 mm longer on average, otherwise the midspan closure gap is about 45 mm short and needs a longer insert. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 工地拼接與焊接收縮預留：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site splices and shrinkage allowance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「肋拼接嵌補段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib splice insert” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以工廠試焊量測實際橫向收縮量，作為放樣加長的依據；工地拼接前量測兩節段端面的間隙、錯邊與肋的對位，焊後量測收縮並更新累積值；面板對接焊以超音波或射線檢測，嵌補肋焊縫以磁粉檢測加超音波檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance; before each site splice, measure gap, misalignment and rib registration at the two segment faces, measure shrinkage after welding and update the running total; test deck butt welds by ultrasonics or radiography and insert-rib welds by magnetic particle plus ultrasonics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：工地焊接須有防風、防雨與預熱措施，焊接程序與焊工須在工地條件下評定；收縮累積表由製造廠與架設單位共同維護，閉合段長度在最後量測後才放樣切割。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Site welding needs wind, rain and preheat protection, with procedures and welders qualified under site conditions; the shrinkage tally is kept jointly by fabricator and erector, and the closure piece is laid out and cut only after the final measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate; insert-rib welds made overhead or vertical in poor site conditions have many root defects and are among the first places to crack by fatigue after opening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以工廠試焊量測實際橫向收縮量，作為放樣加長的依據；工地拼接前量測兩節段端面的間隙、錯邊與肋的對位，焊後量測收縮並更新累積值；面板對接焊以超音波或射線檢測，嵌補肋焊縫以磁粉檢測加超音波檢查。

quiz.question: 要驗證「工地拼接與焊接收縮預留」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site splices and shrinkage allowance"?

Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance; before each site splice, measure gap, misalignment and rib registration at the two segment faces, measure shrinkage after welding and update the running total; test deck butt welds by ultrasonics or radiography and insert-rib welds by magnetic particle plus ultrasonics. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 工地拼接與焊接收縮預留：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site splices and shrinkage allowance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「肋拼接嵌補段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib splice insert” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate; insert-rib welds made overhead or vertical in poor site conditions have many root defects and are among the first places to crack by fatigue after opening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：拼接順序也很關鍵：先焊面板再焊縱肋，或反之，會產生不同的拘束應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Splice sequence also matters: welding the deck plate first or the ribs first produces different restraint stresses.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。
knowledge.textEn: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate; insert-rib welds made overhead or vertical in poor site conditions have many root defects and are among the first places to crack by fatigue after opening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工地拼接與焊接收縮預留」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site splices and shrinkage allowance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。
optionsEn: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside.
quiz.explanation: 沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate; insert-rib welds made overhead or vertical in poor site conditions have many root defects and are among the first places to crack by fatigue after opening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」與「試拼裝與幾何量測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" and "Trial assembly and geometric survey": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Non-destructive testing and penetration verification: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「相位陣列超音波」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Phased-array ultrasonic testing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的焊縫數量以公里計，檢測策略必須分級：面板與主要對接焊做全長超音波或射線檢測；肋—面板部分滲透焊因為根部本來就不熔合，傳統超音波難以區分刻意的未熔合與缺陷，所以需要相位陣列超音波量測熔深，並以巨觀蝕刻試片校正；角焊縫與開孔端部則以目視與磁粉檢測表面裂紋。檢測結果必須與焊接參數紀錄連結，才能找出系統性問題，例如某一台焊機或某一班次的熔深偏低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「相位陣列超音波」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Welds on an orthotropic deck run to kilometres, so inspection must be graded: deck-plate and main butt welds get full-length ultrasonic or radiographic testing; rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds have an intentionally unfused root that conventional ultrasonics struggle to distinguish from defects, so phased-array ultrasonics measure penetration, calibrated against macro-etch specimens; fillet welds and cut-out ends are checked visually and by magnetic particle for surface cracks. Results must be linked to welding-parameter records to reveal systematic problems such as low penetration from a particular machine or shift. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Phased-array ultrasonic testing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：肋壁 t = 8 mm，相位陣列超音波量得未熔合根部高度 1.8 mm，熔深比例 (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%，高於 70% 下限；若量得 2.6 mm，熔深 (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%，低於下限須評估補焊。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a rib wall t = 8 mm, a phased-array measurement of a 1.8 mm unfused root gives a penetration ratio of (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%, above the 70% minimum; a 2.6 mm reading gives (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%, below the minimum, requiring a repair assessment.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「相位陣列超音波」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Phased-array ultrasonic testing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證
knowledge.text: 正交異性橋面的焊縫數量以公里計，檢測策略必須分級：面板與主要對接焊做全長超音波或射線檢測；肋—面板部分滲透焊因為根部本來就不熔合，傳統超音波難以區分刻意的未熔合與缺陷，所以需要相位陣列超音波量測熔深，並以巨觀蝕刻試片校正；角焊縫與開孔端部則以目視與磁粉檢測表面裂紋。檢測結果必須與焊接參數紀錄連結，才能找出系統性問題，例如某一台焊機或某一班次的熔深偏低。
knowledge.textEn: Welds on an orthotropic deck run to kilometres, so inspection must be graded: deck-plate and main butt welds get full-length ultrasonic or radiographic testing; rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds have an intentionally unfused root that conventional ultrasonics struggle to distinguish from defects, so phased-array ultrasonics measure penetration, calibrated against macro-etch specimens; fillet welds and cut-out ends are checked visually and by magnetic particle for surface cracks. Results must be linked to welding-parameter records to reveal systematic problems such as low penetration from a particular machine or shift.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" is correct?
options: 焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。

只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。
optionsEn: A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside.
Welds on an orthotropic deck run to kilometres, so inspection must be graded: deck-plate and main butt welds get full-length ultrasonic or radiographic testing.

steps.title: 焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相位陣列超音波」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Phased-array ultrasonic testing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：肋壁 t = 8 mm，相位陣列超音波量得未熔合根部高度 1.8 mm，熔深比例 (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%，高於 70% 下限；若量得 2.6 mm，熔深 (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%，低於下限須評估補焊。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a rib wall t = 8 mm, a phased-array measurement of a 1.8 mm unfused root gives a penetration ratio of (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%, above the 70% minimum; a 2.6 mm reading gives (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%, below the minimum, requiring a repair assessment. steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the phased-array system on reference blocks of known penetration and cross-check against macro-etch specimens from the same batch; inspectors must hold the relevant qualification, and scan data are archived with position and welding parameters; repairs at rejected locations need their own qualified procedure and re-inspection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 鋼箱梁節段離開工廠前，常把相鄰兩至三個節段在預拼場依設計線形擺放，確認端面間隙、面板錯邊、縱肋對位、拼接板孔位與整體預拱，必要時在工廠內修正，避免到了海上或高空才發現對不上。正交異性橋面的關鍵是縱肋與面板在拼接處的錯邊：對接處的偏心會使局部應力集中，直接縮短疲勞壽命。三維雷射掃描或全站儀量測把每一節段的實際幾何建成數位模型，供架設時模擬閉合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「工廠試拼裝」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before leaving the shop, two or three adjacent box segments are often laid out in the pre-assembly yard on the design alignment to check end gaps, deck-plate misalignment, rib registration, splice-plate hole positions and overall camber, correcting problems in the shop rather than discovering them at sea or at height. For orthotropic decks the key item is misalignment of ribs and plates at splices: eccentricity at a butt joint concentrates local stress and directly shortens fatigue life. 3D laser scanning or total-station surveys build a digital model of each segment's real geometry for simulating closure during erection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shop trial assembly” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Before leaving the shop, two or three adjacent box segments are often laid out in the pre-assembly yard on the design alignment to check end gaps, deck-plate misalignment, rib registration, splice-plate hole positions and overall camber, correcting problems in the shop rather than discovering them at sea or at height.

quiz.explanationEn: Before leaving the shop, two or three adjacent box segments are often laid out in the pre-assembly yard on the design alignment to check end gaps, deck-plate misalignment, rib registration, splice-plate hole positions and overall camber, correcting problems in the shop rather than discovering them at sea or at height. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試拼裝與幾何量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trial assembly and geometric survey: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「工廠試拼裝」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shop trial assembly” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：板件對接錯邊 e 造成的彎曲應力集中係數 SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t。肋壁 t = 8 mm：錯邊 1 mm 時 SCF ≈ 1 + 3×1/8 = 1.375；錯邊 2 mm 時 SCF ≈ 1.75。以 m = 3 的 S–N 曲線，壽命比約 (1.375/1.75)³ ≈ 0.48，錯邊加倍壽命約減半。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Misalignment e at a plate butt joint gives a bending stress concentration factor SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t. For an 8 mm rib wall, 1 mm misalignment gives SCF ≈ 1 + 3×1/8 = 1.375 and 2 mm gives SCF ≈ 1.75. With an m = 3 S–N curve the life ratio is about (1.375/1.75)³ ≈ 0.48, so doubling the misalignment roughly halves the life. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個端面的面板高程、肋位置與間隙，逐肋記錄錯邊並與允差比較；整體預拱與平面線形以設計座標比對，結果製成節段幾何報告，隨節段出廠交給架設單位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During trial assembly survey each face's deck-plate levels, rib positions and gaps by total station or laser scanning, record misalignment rib by rib against tolerance, compare overall camber and plan alignment with design coordinates, and issue a segment geometry report that travels with the segment to the erector.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「試拼裝與幾何量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 試拼裝與幾何量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trial assembly and geometric survey: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「工廠試拼裝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shop trial assembly” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個端面的面板高程、肋位置與間隙，逐肋記錄錯邊並與允差比較；整體預拱與平面線形以設計座標比對，結果製成節段幾何報告，隨節段出廠交給架設單位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During trial assembly survey each face's deck-plate levels, rib positions and gaps by total station or laser scanning, record misalignment rib by rib against tolerance, compare overall camber and plan alignment with design coordinates, and issue a segment geometry report that travels with the segment to the erector. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約應規定試拼裝的範圍與頻率、錯邊與間隙允差，以及不符合時的修正程序；節段幾何報告與數位模型屬於竣工資料的一部分，供日後檢查與維修使用。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略試拼裝，到了架設現場才發現縱肋錯位數公釐，只能以強制對位或加墊板處理，在拼接處留下錯邊與附加應力；拼接板孔位不符時現場擴孔，削弱摩擦型螺栓接合的性能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping trial assembly lets ribs arrive several millimetres out of register, forcing them together or shimming and leaving misalignment and added stress at splices; mismatched splice holes are reamed on site, weakening slip-critical bolted joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 試拼裝與幾何量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trial assembly and geometric survey: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「工廠試拼裝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shop trial assembly” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略試拼裝，到了架設現場才發現縱肋錯位數公釐，只能以強制對位或加墊板處理，在拼接處留下錯邊與附加應力；拼接板孔位不符時現場擴孔，削弱摩擦型螺栓接合的性能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping trial assembly lets ribs arrive several millimetres out of register, forcing them together or shimming and leaving misalignment and added stress at splices; mismatched splice holes are reamed on site, weakening slip-critical bolted joints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：三維雷射掃描或全站儀量測把每一節段的實際幾何建成數位模型，供架設時模擬閉合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: 3D laser scanning or total-station surveys build a digital model of each segment's real geometry for simulating closure during erection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「試拼裝與幾何量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋪面系統與面板協同作用」與「疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Surfacing system and composite action with the plate" and "Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「環氧瀝青鋪面」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的鋪面不只是行車表面：它把輪載分散到較大面積，並在低溫時與鋼面板部分合成，顯著降低面板與焊縫的應力幅；同時保護鋼面板免受水與鹽侵蝕。金門大橋 1980 年代換裝的鋼橋面採用約 2 吋（約 50 mm）的環氧瀝青鋪面。鋪面的勁度隨溫度大幅改變，夏季高溫時合成效果降低，面板應力上升；鋪面開裂或與鋼板脫層，則同時失去分散荷載與防水兩種功能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「環氧瀝青鋪面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The surfacing on an orthotropic deck is more than a running surface: it spreads wheel loads over a larger area and, when cold, acts partly compositely with the steel plate, markedly reducing stress ranges in the plate and welds, while protecting the plate from water and salt. The Golden Gate Bridge's 1980s steel deck received about 2 inches (about 50 mm) of epoxy asphalt. Surfacing stiffness changes greatly with temperature, so composite action drops in hot summers and plate stresses rise; cracking or debonding of the surfacing loses both load spreading and waterproofing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：16 mm 鋼面板加 50 mm 鋪面，假設完全合成：鋪面模數 5,000 MPa（約常溫）時板條抗彎勁度約為鋼板單獨的 5.3 倍；高溫降到 1,000 MPa 時只剩約 1.9 倍；低溫 10,000 MPa 時約 9.1 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone; at 1,000 MPa in hot weather only about 1.9 times; at 10,000 MPa in cold weather about 9.1 times.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「環氧瀝青鋪面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「鋪面系統與面板協同作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: The surfacing on an orthotropic deck is more than a running surface: it spreads wheel loads over a larger area and, when cold, acts partly compositely with the steel plate, markedly reducing stress ranges in the plate and welds, while protecting the plate from water and salt.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環氧瀝青鋪面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：16 mm 鋼面板加 50 mm 鋪面，假設完全合成：鋪面模數 5,000 MPa（約常溫）時板條抗彎勁度約為鋼板單獨的 5.3 倍；高溫降到 1,000 MPa 時只剩約 1.9 倍；低溫 10,000 MPa 時約 9.1 倍。勁度比的變化說明夏季重車造成的應力幅最大。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone; at 1,000 MPa in hot weather only about 1.9 times; at 10,000 MPa in cold weather about 9.1 times. The variation shows why heavy trucks in summer cause the largest stress ranges. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋪設前檢查鋼面板噴砂等級、粗糙度與防蝕底漆，鋪面材料做配比與黏結強度試驗；鋪設後以拉拔試驗抽查與鋼板的黏結，並以敲擊或熱像檢查脫層；通車初期在面板下方貼應變計量測不同季節的應力幅，驗證設計假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength; after paving, spot-check bond by pull-off tests and look for debonding by sounding or thermography; in the first years, gauge the plate underside to measure stress ranges in different seasons and verify design assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環氧瀝青鋪面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋪設前檢查鋼面板噴砂等級、粗糙度與防蝕底漆，鋪面材料做配比與黏結強度試驗；鋪設後以拉拔試驗抽查與鋼板的黏結，並以敲擊或熱像檢查脫層；通車初期在面板下方貼應變計量測不同季節的應力幅，驗證設計假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength; after paving, spot-check bond by pull-off tests and look for debonding by sounding or thermography; in the first years, gauge the plate underside to measure stress ranges in different seasons and verify design assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋪面系統（防蝕層、黏結層、鋪面）應與鋼橋面一起設計與驗收，規格中明訂適用溫度範圍與黏結強度；維護計畫須包括鋪面裂縫的即時封填，避免水分進入鋼板界面。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design and accept the surfacing system (corrosion layer, bond coat, surfacing) together with the steel deck, specifying the temperature range and bond strength; the maintenance plan must include prompt sealing of surfacing cracks so water cannot reach the steel interface.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環氧瀝青鋪面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋪面的勁度隨溫度大幅改變，夏季高溫時合成效果降低，面板應力上升；鋪面開裂或與鋼板脫層，則同時失去分散荷載與防水兩種功能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surfacing stiffness changes greatly with temperature, so composite action drops in hot summers and plate stresses rise; cracking or debonding of the surfacing loses both load spreading and waterproofing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

optionsEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

steps.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「疲勞熱點檢查清單」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。根部向面板成長的裂縫從上方被鋪面遮住、從箱內看不到焊縫內部，往往要到鋪面沿肋線開裂才被發現。因此交接時必須提供以熱點為主的檢查清單、箱內通行路線、可用的超音波檢測方法，以及依裂縫成長速度訂定的檢查週期；修復可用止裂孔、螺栓補強板或橋面加鋪高性能混凝土層。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「疲勞熱點檢查清單」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds. Root cracks growing into the plate are hidden by surfacing from above and invisible inside the weld from within the box, so they are often found only when the surfacing cracks along rib lines. Handover must therefore supply a hot-spot inspection checklist, access routes inside the box, suitable ultrasonic methods and inspection intervals based on crack-growth rates; repairs include stop holes, bolted doubler plates or an overlay of high-performance concrete on the deck. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Paris 定律 da/dN = C·(ΔK)³，ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa)，C = 3×10⁻¹³（mm 與 MPa√mm）、Y = 1.12、Δσ = 40 MPa。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Paris law da/dN = C·(ΔK)³ with ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa), C = 3×10⁻¹³ (mm and MPa√mm), Y = 1.12 and Δσ = 40 MPa.
